title_en: Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues concerning the Application of the Company Law of the People's Republic of China (II)

articles.content_en: Article 2 Where a shareholder initiates an action for dissolution of the company and simultaneously applies to the People's Court for liquidation of the company, the People's Court shall not accept the liquidation application. The People's Court may inform the plaintiff that, after the People's Court renders a judgment dissolving the company, the plaintiff may organize liquidation on its own or separately apply to the People's Court for liquidation of the company in accordance with Article 70 of the Civil Code, Article 183 of the Company Law, and Article 7 of these Provisions.

Article 3 Where a shareholder, when initiating an action for dissolution of the company, applies to the People's Court for property preservation or evidence preservation, the People's Court may grant the preservation if the shareholder provides security and the normal operation of the company is not affected.

Article 4 A shareholder initiating an action for dissolution of the company shall name the company as the defendant.
Where the plaintiff also initiates the action against other shareholders as defendants, the People's Court shall inform the plaintiff to change the other shareholders to third parties; if the plaintiff insists on not making the change, the People's Court shall dismiss the plaintiff's prosecution against the other shareholders.
The plaintiff initiating an action for dissolution of the company shall notify the other shareholders, or the People's Court shall notify them to participate in the action. Where other shareholders or relevant interested parties apply to participate in the action as co-plaintiffs or third parties, the People's Court shall permit it.

Article 5 When hearing a case of action for dissolution of the company, the People's Court shall focus on mediation. Where the parties agree through consultation that the company or shareholders shall purchase shares, or that the company shall continue to exist by means of capital reduction or other methods, and such agreement does not violate the mandatory provisions of laws and administrative regulations, the People's Court shall support it. Where the parties cannot reach an agreement to enable the company to continue to exist, the People's Court shall render a judgment in a timely manner.
Where, through mediation by the People's Court, the company purchases the plaintiff's shares, the company shall transfer or cancel the shares within six months from the date the mediation document takes effect. Before the shares are transferred or cancelled, the plaintiff shall not oppose the company's creditors on the grounds of the company's purchase of its shares.

Article 6 A judgment rendered by the People's Court in an action for dissolution of the company is legally binding on all shareholders of the company.
After the People's Court renders a judgment rejecting the claim in an action for dissolution of the company, if the shareholder who brought the action or another shareholder again initiates an action for dissolution of the company on the same facts and grounds, the People's Court shall not accept it.

Article 10 Before a company completes liquidation according to law and undergoes cancellation registration, civil actions concerning the company shall be conducted in the name of the company.
Where the company has established a liquidation group, the person in charge of the liquidation group shall represent the company in the action; where no liquidation group has yet been established, the original legal representative shall represent the company in the action.

Article 11 When a company is under liquidation, the liquidation group shall, in accordance with Article 185 of the Company Law, notify all known creditors in writing of the matters concerning dissolution and liquidation of the company, and, depending on the company's scale and the scope of its business territory, make a public announcement in an influential newspaper at the national level or at the provincial level of the place where the company is registered.
Where the liquidation group fails to perform the obligation of notification and announcement in accordance with the preceding paragraph, causing creditors to fail to declare their claims in a timely manner and thereby remain unsatisfied, and creditors claim that the members of the liquidation group shall bear compensation liability for the losses caused thereby, the People's Court shall support the claim according to law.

Article 12 When a company is under liquidation, if a creditor objects to the claim verified by the liquidation group, the creditor may request the liquidation group to re-verify it. If the liquidation group refuses to re-verify, or the creditor still objects to the re-verified claim, and the creditor initiates an action in the People's Court against the company as defendant to request confirmation, the People's Court shall accept the case.

Article 13 Where a creditor fails to declare a claim within the prescribed period but makes a supplementary declaration before the conclusion of the company's liquidation procedures, the liquidation group shall register it.
The conclusion of the company's liquidation procedures refers to the final confirmation of the liquidation report by the shareholders' meeting, the shareholders' general meeting, or the People's Court.

Article 14 The claim supplementary declared by a creditor may be satisfied according to law from the company's undistributed property. Where the company's undistributed property cannot fully satisfy the claim, and the creditor claims that shareholders shall satisfy it with the property they have already obtained in the distribution of residual property, the People's Court shall support the claim, unless the creditor failed to declare the claim within the prescribed period due to gross negligence.
Where a creditor or the liquidation group applies to the People's Court for bankruptcy liquidation on the grounds that the company's undistributed property and the property already obtained by shareholders in the distribution of residual property cannot fully satisfy the supplementary declared claim, the People's Court shall not accept the application.

Article 15 Where a company conducts liquidation on its own, the liquidation plan shall be submitted to the shareholders' meeting or the shareholders' general meeting for confirmation by resolution; where the People's Court organizes liquidation, the liquidation plan shall be submitted to the People's Court for confirmation. The liquidation group shall not execute a liquidation plan that has not been confirmed.
Where executing an unconfirmed liquidation plan causes losses to the company or creditors, and the company, shareholders, directors, other interested parties of the company, or creditors claim that the members of the liquidation group shall bear compensation liability, the People's Court shall support the claim according to law.

Article 16 Where the People's Court organizes liquidation, the liquidation group shall complete the liquidation within six months from the date of its establishment.
Where the liquidation cannot be completed within six months due to special circumstances, the liquidation group shall apply to the People's Court for an extension.

Article 17 When the liquidation group designated by the People's Court, in clearing the company's property and preparing the balance sheet and property inventory, discovers that the company's property is insufficient to satisfy its debts, it may consult with creditors to formulate a debt repayment plan.
Where the debt repayment plan is confirmed by all creditors and does not harm the interests of other interested parties, the People's Court may, upon application by the liquidation group, rule to approve it. After satisfying debts in accordance with the repayment plan, the liquidation group shall apply to the People's Court for a ruling to conclude the liquidation procedures.
Where creditors do not confirm the debt repayment plan, or the People's Court does not approve it, the liquidation group shall apply to the People's Court according to law for a declaration of bankruptcy.

Article 18 Where shareholders of a limited liability company, or directors and controlling shareholders of a joint stock limited company, fail to establish a liquidation group and commence liquidation within the statutory time limit, resulting in depreciation, loss, damage, or destruction of the company's property, and creditors claim that they shall bear compensation liability for the company's debts within the scope of the losses caused, the People's Court shall support the claim according to law.
Where shareholders of a limited liability company, or directors and controlling shareholders of a joint stock limited company, neglect their duties, causing the loss or destruction of the company's principal property, account books, important documents, and the like, making liquidation impossible, and creditors claim that they shall bear joint and several repayment liability for the company's debts, the People's Court shall support the claim according to law.
Where the above circumstances are caused by the actual controller, and creditors claim that the actual controller shall bear corresponding civil liability for the company's debts, the People's Court shall support the claim according to law.

Article 19 Where shareholders of a limited liability company, directors and controlling shareholders of a joint stock limited company, and the actual controller of the company, after the dissolution of the company, maliciously dispose of the company's property, causing losses to creditors, or, without liquidation according to law, use a false liquidation report to defraud the company registration authority into completing the cancellation registration of the legal person, and creditors claim that they shall bear corresponding compensation liability for the company's debts, the People's Court shall support the claim according to law.

Article 20 A company shall, upon dissolution, apply for cancellation registration after liquidation has been completed according to law. Where the company undergoes cancellation registration without liquidation, making it impossible to liquidate the company, and creditors claim that the shareholders of a limited liability company, the directors and controlling shareholders of a joint stock limited company, and the actual controller of the company shall bear repayment liability for the company's debts, the People's Court shall support the claim according to law.
Where the company undergoes cancellation registration without liquidation according to law, and a shareholder or a third party, at the time of undergoing cancellation registration with the company registration authority, undertakes to bear liability for the company's debts, and creditors claim that they shall bear corresponding civil liability for the company's debts, the People's Court shall support the claim according to law.

Article 21 Where there are two or more persons who shall bear liability pursuant to Article 18 and paragraph 1 of Article 20 of these Provisions, namely, shareholders of a limited liability company, directors and controlling shareholders of a joint stock limited company, and the actual controller of the company, if one or several of them, after bearing civil liability according to law, claim that the other persons shall share the liability according to the degree of fault, the People's Court shall support the claim according to law.

Article 22 When the company is dissolved, the capital contributions not yet paid by shareholders shall all be included in the liquidation property. The capital contributions not yet paid by shareholders include contributions that have become due but are unpaid, and contributions payable in installments in accordance with Articles 26 and 80 of the Company Law for which the payment period has not yet expired.
Where the company's property is insufficient to satisfy its debts, and creditors claim that shareholders who have not paid their contributions, as well as other shareholders or promoters at the time of the company's establishment, shall bear joint and several repayment liability for the company's debts within the scope of the unpaid contributions, the People's Court shall support the claim according to law.

Article 23 Where a member of the liquidation group, when handling liquidation affairs, violates laws, administrative regulations, or the company's articles of association, causing losses to the company or creditors, and the company or creditors claim that the member shall bear compensation liability, the People's Court shall support the claim according to law.
Where shareholders of a limited liability company, or shareholders of a joint stock limited company who individually or jointly hold 1 percent or more of the company's shares for 180 consecutive days or more, initiate an action in the People's Court in accordance with paragraph 3 of Article 151 of the Company Law on the ground that a member of the liquidation group has committed the acts described in the preceding paragraph, the People's Court shall accept the case.
Where the company has completed liquidation and been deregistered, and the above-mentioned shareholders directly initiate an action in the People's Court by reference to paragraph 3 of Article 151 of the Company Law, with the member of the liquidation group as defendant and other shareholders as third parties, the People's Court shall accept the case.

Article 24 Cases of actions for dissolution of a company and company liquidation cases shall be under the jurisdiction of the People's Court at the domicile of the company. The domicile of a company refers to the place where its principal office is located. Where the place of the company's office is unclear, the case shall be under the jurisdiction of the People's Court at the place of its registration.
Primary People's Courts shall have jurisdiction over cases of actions for dissolution and company liquidation cases of companies registered upon approval by the company registration authority of a county, a county-level city, or a district; Intermediate People's Courts shall have jurisdiction over cases of actions for dissolution and company liquidation cases of companies registered upon approval by the company registration authority of a prefecture or a prefecture-level city or above.
